videos.title: AI Agents Explained
videos.description:
If your AI just talks to you, you're only using 10% of what's possible 💀⁠
⁠
A chatbot can help you plan your day. An AI agent checks your calendar, drafts the email, sends it, AND follows up when nobody replies, all on its own.⁠
⁠
That's the difference: chatbots chat. Agents ACT.⁠
⁠
Since 2025, "agentic" has been THE word in AI, and the people learning to build and work with agents now are the ones capturing the real opportunities.⁠
⁠
Save this 🔖 and send it to your friend who thinks AI = ChatGPT
⁠
Follow + comment which AI concept I should break down next 👇⁠
⁠

videos.title: Tony Robbins: Start Here If Your Mind Doesn't Cooperate, BUT You Want MORE
videos.description:
Most people don't change until it hurts enough. Tony Robbins says that's not laziness. It's that the thing you're trying to quit is already feeding needs you don't know you have.

In this clip, Tony Robbins and Jay Shetty talk about the six human needs Tony found after working in more than 100 countries, and why 90% of people chase certainty and significance when what they actually want is love.

Tony breaks down why fear is really just uncertainty wearing a different name, what a nurse accidentally discovered in a World War II field hospital, and why a belief will never do what an experience does.

Learn about the seasons of history that decide what your twenties feel like, why Tony says we've been in winter since 2008, and what most Fortune 1000 companies have in common with the year they were founded.

videos.title: How this “non-coder” used Cursor to add AI to retro hardware
videos.description:
Maddie Reese is a vibe coder, hardware tinkerer, and builder. She builds things at the intersection of software and hardware, including a thermal receipt printer that people around the world can message directly, a fully functional Twitter pager running on a Raspberry Pi, and a personal API that tells you her coffee order so you don’t have to ask. Maddie approaches hardware the same way she approaches software: dump the idea into Cursor, let it interview her, get a shopping list, triple-check the parts before buying, and build. She got her start after her dad introduced her to Lovable, and she locked herself in her room and didn’t come up for air.

*What you’ll learn:*
1. How Maddie built a thermal receipt printer that accepts messages from anywhere in the world using a Raspberry Pi and Bluetooth
2. How to use Cursor’s agent view to brainstorm a hardware project
3. What belongs in a personal API and why agents, not just humans, will be the ones using it
4. How to read just enough code to do some damage, without needing to understand all of it
5. Why building for fun, not practicality, is the fastest path to actually shipping physical projects

*Brought to you by:*
Firecrawl—Power AI agents with clean web data: https://firecrawl.dev/?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=how_i_ai
Customer.io—Build customer engagement campaigns from a single prompt: https://www.customer.io/howiai
